about_the_game:
Gameplay

Players will portray the role of a shaman wielding spirit power, journeying through an enchanted scroll that unveils the mystical realm of the Shan Hai Jing to awaken the slumbering creatures within. Players will build a home for them on a hidden island, gather precious resources and spirit energy, and fulfill their delightful little wishes, weaving a journey full of wonder and enchantment.

Background

In ancient times, when the pillars of Mount Buzhou shattered and the world was plunged into a calamity of water and flames, Goddess Nuwa mend the sky with colorful stones, saving all living beings. 

Thereafter, all of the creations flourished under her protection. Tme dances with the promise of renewal, and thousands of years have since elapsed.

One day, a shaman named “Wu”, imbued with spiritual power that could communicate with nature, received a divine commission from Nuwa herself.

Long ago, as Nuwa journeyed across the vast earth, she was captivated by the ethereal beauty of creation. To immortalize these moments, she crafted the mystical Mirror Scroll—a wondrous record of mountains and seas. When Mount Buzhou collapsed, many mythical beings tragically perished. Touched with compassion, Nuwa sealed their shattered souls within the scroll, hoping that one day their broken essences might be mended.

Now, as these souls grow near wholeness, they stand on the verge of awakening from  thousand years of slumber. Deep within the Eastern Sea lies an immortal island—a haven untouched by the mortal world and brimming with vibrant spiritual energy. Nuwa entrusts Wu with the task of journeying there to awaken, and guide the reborn creatures from the magical scroll, help restore their memories, and build them a new home, so that amid the ever-changing tides of time, they may again find a place to belong.

Core Elements

  • Shan Hai Jing (Classic of Mountains and Seas)

  • Collection

  • Construction

  • Exploration
